Name: Night Time Sound Notifications
Author: CarelessImm0rtal
Description:
This mod adds an audio notification at 12am, 1am, and 1:30am - for those who lose track of time.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
To use sound, you must run mod for the first time to generate a config. This will allow you to change selected sound notification. It is currently set to 'secret1', which will sound like a long chime.
Sounds that can be used are included in this file below:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CpDrw23peQiq-C7F2FjYOMePaYe0Rc9BwQsj3h6sjyo/edit#gid=239695361 

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. Each player will hear the sounds independently, it only plays for those who have it installed.
[/list]
